notes: Volumetric (Sieverts-type) H2 isotherms, 233-298 K (plus 318 K for MWNT) up to ~11 MPa, on AX-21 activated carbon and a CVD MWNT; void volume by helium expansion; uptake basis not named. Fig. 3 gives full isotherms in wt%; Table 1 gives 6 MPa values. I4 also supported for AX-21: 'It possesses specific surface area of about 3000 m2/g' (p. 1, Section 2), a value stated for the product used, not a class-typical value; the MWNT BET value (137 m2/g) cites ref. [21], the authors' own 2003 workshop report. The AX-21 heat of adsorption is quoted from the authors' earlier work [20] and [20] is an earlier H2-on-activated-carbon study, but the paper does not state that its uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. Journal citation reads Int J Hydrogen Energy 29 (2004) 475-479 (accepted 2003); record year 2003. Not retracted per record and PDF.
